project: Vision & Value Overseas (VNVNEPAL) — ethical overseas manpower recruitment agency, Kathmandu
stack: TanStack Start (React 19 + Vite 8 + Nitro) frontend; Django 6 + DRF backend; SQLite
render_mode: SSR (TanStack Start / Nitro); hybrid with client interactivity
frontend: web/ — file-based routes, route head meta, static content from src/data/site.ts
backend: server/ — Django REST API under /api/ for pages, jobs, news, FAQs, forms

items.name: Website / page purpose
items.evidence: web/src/routes/* — dedicated routes (/about, /services, /vacancies, /news, /contact) each cover one topic

items.name: SEO basics

notes: Confirmed: robots.txt without Sitemap; no sitemap.xml; no JSON-LD; no canonicals; no og:image; no SITE_URL.

Local NAP in site.ts; LocalBusiness schema missing.
